### Do Liver Cleanses Work?

- **Natural Function:** Your liver and kidneys already filter waste, process alcohol, and clean your blood continuously on their own.
- **Regulation and Safety:** Over-the-counter detox pills, teas, and kits are **not regulated** by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
- **Risks:** Some herbal cleanses or high-dose supplements have been linked to drug-induced liver injury or added stress to the organ.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF1zk2GX5DjkNAIap0g5JEFq6ckzU20YvtrT549AkWP-R9Ke5pLQODiydy9HBgbvV0J13WFSk8fgdMBzp_REyH4qEIh5Sl9_Jk95-t9muudO9C4nmQ8Bu6_ogZJC62MA9l0WZPxXQTb3dUgQPsAalp4Tl6XLDTDOs58X45ZjM506bBYHdGoBQfgUSKIUnOUKKufzYqKYgYmsUFVPj32A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXwKIOzIzDts7qF-7MG1eaDm-FzzTWIFEGiG7woKGW5rizcRD-tjFUvgvqgopdVi5_Vfs7LF_K8_rLVDkUviSUSnpO8RG1se6nLBsGjF-f2F0OF9AElYcvIavTLhVwpsYV6zhN)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF154kdSic3Y6UUNGCwaAlwP8F9ASMI2oGWIkRXdPdOi6msWJ18x7weLabQTdeswGoluAyO_Iok-rYmSmZ5nwvEvyDuPVlPqEZ2rT989htc2khC0__T2EV7cbe7dagpdrlYszRDbbF1VUqbucbWhERjaJJTgPZgvnxpRorBTukAbHDmUAd1RLaxj4-k5Q4eaLV5A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXg4YycIyKzhKUWwVRyW_B0jNHBSrg6xQge8sOjshbDYBbBw4ms7CKgb_m1tSrarWhe8my3sccr2l3pcSMJZSDTj3OXm05WgJ4zK41CpZnpP4EGovVs0VpGBlrUmYq27iSzUg)

### How to Safely Support Your Liver

According to [Johns Hopkins Medicine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF154kdSic3Y6UUNGCwaAlwP8F9ASMI2oGWIkRXdPdOi6msWJ18x7weLabQTdeswGoluAyO_Iok-rYmSmZ5nwvEvyDuPVlPqEZ2rT989htc2khC0__T2EV7cbe7dagpdrlYszRDbbF1VUqbucbWhERjaJJTgPZgvnxpRorBTukAbHDmUAd1RLaxj4-k5Q4eaLV5A) and health authorities, you can maintain long-term liver health through safe, everyday habits:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1w0SGb5N3G65wi5nEqp4yQEEVILMkmq0ctZmZarbfXcEO6rSEh0MWkYuI0BgUUUhXcZUpIt1EcFT5CRLohE3PER13miLOFS1wMTzPyOXCrUqPFUMp9Z6dP3eVEQ2jkj2gwUO_ta9AEfdf-9NifLwx0LweJsFzGciAt8YOZG7h9fYCQ-ftqaPVvRd0JutU8sjk-M-HCZhWJ9pt8ELZdW393mFHgG7PkdTz89d0rmFfIpBKYXxHZNRIg4tq17zQ7iQpc4iRY9DE4UR6ZUJBUzV)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF154kdSic3Y6UUNGCwaAlwP8F9ASMI2oGWIkRXdPdOi6msWJ18x7weLabQTdeswGoluAyO_Iok-rYmSmZ5nwvEvyDuPVlPqEZ2rT989htc2khC0__T2EV7cbe7dagpdrlYszRDbbF1VUqbucbWhERjaJJTgPZgvnxpRorBTukAbHDmUAd1RLaxj4-k5Q4eaLV5A)

- **Limit Alcohol:** Keep alcohol consumption within moderate limits (no more than two drinks per day for women, or three for men).

- **Stay Hydrated:** Drink plenty of water throughout the day.
